# Yumeyakata Kimono Rental Kyoto

> > Authentic kimono rental and cultural experience service in Kyoto, offering traditional Japanese attire with expert styling and guidance for exploring historic sites.

Yumeyakata provides kimono rental services in Kyoto, Japan, combining traditional Japanese fashion with cultural education. The site features guides on kimono types, seasonal styling, historical sites near their locations, and practical information for visitors experiencing Kyoto in authentic Japanese dress.

## Key Topics

- Kimono rental services
- Kyoto sightseeing
- Traditional Japanese clothing (Wafuku)
- Furisode and Homongi kimono types
- Obi belt styling
- Seasonal kimono (Hitoe, Awase, Natsumono)
- Edo period history
- Heian period culture
- Kyoto temples and shrines
- Sagano and Arashiyama districts
- Traditional Japanese colors
- Kimono accessories
- Shinsengumi history
- Nijo Castle
- Japanese cultural experiences

## Kimono Knowledge & Styling Guide

- [Kimono Calendar](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/kimono-calender): Seasonal kimono calendar: Hitoe, Awase, Natsumono types by season
- [Obi Belt Knots](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/knots-of-obi-belts): Guide to obi belt knots and kimono accessories styling techniques
- [Wafuku and Kimono](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/wafuku-and-kimono): Explanation of wafuku vs kimono terminology and Japanese clothing history
- [Traditional Japanese Colors and Kimono](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/traditional-japanese-colors-and-kimono): Guide to traditional Japanese colors in kimono styling and accessories

## Kyoto Historical Sites & Temples

- [Karamon Gate at Nijo Castle](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/karamon-gate-at-nijo-castle): Guide to Karamon Gate at Nijo Castle World Heritage site near Yumeyakata
- [Yagi Residence - Former Shinsengumi Headquarters](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/yagi-residence-the-former-shinsengumi-headquarters): Historical guide to Yagi Residence, former Shinsengumi headquarters in Mibu
- [Jojakkoji Temple in Winter](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/jojakkoji-temple-in-winter): Winter scenery guide to Jojakkoji Temple in Sagano, Kyoto
- [Katoumado Flower-Shaped Window at Kodai-ji Temple](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/katoumado-flower-shaped-window-at-todai-ji-temple): Katoumado flower-shaped window at Kodai-ji Temple architectural feature

## Seasonal Experiences in Kyoto

- [Fallen Leaves](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/fallen-leaves): Autumn foliage and fallen leaves experience in Kyoto by Yumeyakata

## Visitor Information & Support

- [Kyoto City Fire Department Emergency Number 119](https://www.en-kyoto.yumeyakata.com/kyoto-city-fire-department-emergency-number-119): Emergency services info: Kyoto Fire Department multilingual support 119
